verdict.rationale: Florida DOR documents an electronic file-and-pay program for entities submitting large reemployment-tax data files. It publishes a downloadable XML schema/XPath package and offers agents with 100+ clients a batch enrollment file. The enrollment path is only partly published: the batch specifications must be requested by email, and the evidence does not describe a transmitter signup or system-account procedure. Missing for 10: a published transmitter/bulk-filer enrollment or approval process, documentation of system-account credentials for machine submission, openly available batch technical specifications, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, a documented system-to-system channel exists for software to transact with the service (system accounts, transmitter programs, batch providers), with the enrollment path published

citations.quote: The Department has established an electronic file and pay program for entities submitting large data files with reemployment tax information.
The XPath document and Florida XML Schemas have been updated to include additional E-Verify certification fields. Download the Reemployment Tax XML Package
If an agent has 100 or more clients to add or delete, the agent may use a batch enrollment file. To request access to the Batch Enrollment Technical Specifications, send an email
